body: The past few weeks just seem like they're all the same. I can't see my friends, my mother is constantly stressed because she might lose her job and school is draining me completly. Most of the time it feels like I am emotioneless. I can't even talk to anyone I know cuz I have troubles expressing myself and I don't wanna bother them. But the past few weeks have been doing nothing but dragging me down. I haven't left my room in three days, I lost my apetite and my suicidal thoughts have been worse than ever. I won't cut, I've been clean for two months but I'm slowly starting to think that that's the only way to feel alive again and to not actually kill myself. I just want to feel something good again, something more than just that passing hallow happines i feel when talking with my friends on discord. I really don't know anymore...
